--------
Order No. 06/dated 13.09.2024 Heard learned senior counsel assisted by the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant, who appeared through V.C.
2.

This bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with prayer to release on bail in connection with Giridih (M) P.S. Case No. 09 of 2024, corresponding G.R. Case No.1288 of 2024, S.T. Case No. 229 of 2024 registered under Sections 376(2)(N), of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-V, Giridih.
3.

The F.I.R of this case was lodged by the victim herself wherein the allegations are made that the petitioner has been establishing physical relation with her for last five years and he also assured her that he would marry with her.
On 03.01.2024 at 7:00 o'clock, the petitioner has come to Giridih, and called her over mobile phone.
She also reached the house of her relative and there she came to know that the petitioner Pawan Mandal is married having two children.
On 04.01.2024, the family members of Pawan Mandal had hurled abuse to her and on this very issue, the quarrel took place.
Hence, this FIR was lodged.

4. Leaned senior counsel for the petitioner drew attention to this Court to Paragraph Nos.12 and 13 of this bail petition, wherein it is mentioned that the marriage of victim had taken place in the year 2013 and also has a ten year old child and she has solemnized second marriage in the year 2022.

1 5.
In the FIR itself, the age of victim is shown 25 years.

As per allegations made in the FIR she had been establishing physical relation with the petitioner on pretext of marriage for the last five years,
at that time too, the victim was major one, admittedly, the victim was also married prior to establishing physical relation with the present petitioner.

The victim being major was also aware of marriage with another person because she herself was married, was not legally permissible still she continued established physical relation with the petitioner.
6. In view of the above, the bail petition of the petitioner is allowed.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned in the aforesaid case.
